actual: The validation selector treats module ownership as full test applicability. Factor-research Skill/command and documentation-only changes inherit factor_research_backend and factor_research_dev_db, so finish requires irrelevant DEV write receipts although no repository, SQL, transaction, migration, or database-call contract changed. Fix applicability selection generically: docs-only and instruction-only changes receive docs/format/scope plus precise workflow contract smoke; executable scripts under controlled paths remain code; computation changes receive relevant compute tests; repository/SQL/transaction/migration/database-contract changes retain DEV plans; mixed diffs take the union. Align local finish and CI classification, expose per-plan trigger reasons, and add regression tests without any BUG-1430-specific bypass.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
